messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT 1768904321 - Elevated 5xx/timeouts detected on hosted-api gateway across us-east-1. Error rate spike from 0.3% -> 8% over last 3m. Paging oncall.

matt: getting paged, joining. seeing a lot of gateway 502/504s and long tail p95 > 3s. metrics show scheduler_queue_depth rising, avg batch wait up to 1.6s. head-of-line blocking on batcher-3.

sara: confirmed. kv-cache miss rate also spiked, but majority looks like batches waiting on tokenization/decoder slots. live batches piling up: ~18k queued across pool.

liam: any customer impact? support noting elevated errors for webhooks and streaming sessions.

zoe: Support -> several paid customers reporting timeouts; preliminary count ~12 distinct accounts, about 5% of traffic for some tenants. CS flagged one paying customer on dedicated plan with 30% dropped requests.

matt: timeline: spike started ~1768904200, ramped quickly. root cause likely scheduler saturation from sudden burst of long-context requests. suspect a small percent of requests are causing oversized batches and locking slots.

sara: quick mitigations we can do now: 1) enable gateway circuit-breaker for high-payload requests 2) route new incoming to fallback model variant (smaller, quantized) 3) trigger aggressive eviction policy on oldest queued requests 4) bump up batcher pool size temporarily.

liam: executing fallback route now: /ops/route set-policy --from hosted-api --to-model rwd-7b-quant --condition "seq_len>8192 or payload>200k". rolling out 30% traffic to fallback.

sara: running eviction: ops evict-queued --pool batcher-3 --mode oldest --limit 6000  # evict oldest 6k to reduce HOL

matt: enabling circuit breaker at gateway: nginx: upstream_keepalive 64 -> set reject_on_queue=true for large requests. pushing config.

zoe: scaling batcher pool: autoscale override +4 nodes for batcher-3. infra run: infra autoscale batcher-3 +4 --ttl 20m

incident-bot: NOTE: Canaries enabled: rwd-7b-quant receives 30% traffic, batcher-3 scaled +4, eviction in progress. Monitor: p50/p95/p99 and 5xx rate.

sara: after eviction and reroute, queue depth dropping from 18k -> 7.2k in 3m. 5xx rate dropping to 2.1% now. p95 latency down to 1.4s. still above baseline but improving.

liam: continuing to observe a tail of long tokenization jobs. creating a short-term guard: reject requests with declared context >120k tokens with 413 to avoid runaway. patching gateway rule.

matt: handoff to night oncall (zoe) in 15m. leaving checklist: (1) keep reroute at 30% until p95<1s and 5xx<0.5% for 10m; (2) verify no new large job spikes in logs; (3) follow up auto-evict thresholds.

zoe: acknowledged. raising post-incident ticket for long-context client throttling and docs update. tagging product & SDK teams to add client-side guidance.

sara: brief note for support: affected customers: list pinned in #support-incidents, CS notified and templates queued. recommend offering retries with exponential backoff.

matt: root-cause hypothesis: a burst of long-window streaming requests with large context lengths pushed batcher into HOL state; kv-cache churn amplified tokenization latency. mitigation path: stronger input size guards + dynamic batching heuristics + prioritized short requests.

zoe: I'll keep monitoring. will escalate back to eng if 5xx climbs >3% again. handing off at 1768904389.

incident-bot: 👋 Incident update: mitigations applied. Status: partial mitigation. Next update or closure pending metrics stabilization.
